issues: Meaning drift: "SALINAN" should be rendered as "COPY OF" (official copy), not "COPY".
Meaning drift: "Menetapkan" in this context is better translated as "Stipulates" (or "Enacts"), not "To Establish".

Leftover non-legal text included: repeated website line "www.jdih.bangkaselatankab.go.id" appears in the translation though it is not part of the legal provisions and should be removed for downstream processing consistency.

Scrambled/merged list markers and items: several lettered items are run together (e.g., 'c.' with 'd.'; 'andj.'; 'andd.'; 'andk.'; 'andd.' in Article 6(2); 'ande.' in Article 8), and Article 5 paragraph numbering '(2)' is merged into item k.

Markdown/list structure not faithfully preserved: original has separate list items a–j in Article 2, a–d in Article 3, a–d in Article 4, a–k plus paragraphs (2) and 3 in Article 5, a–d in Article 6(2), a–h in Article 7, a–e in Article 8; translation collapses some into single lines, risking boundary-based retrieval errors.

Broken numbering/list structure: in Article 5 the original has items 1., (2), 3., but the translation uses 1., (2), 3. (missing parentheses on (1) and inconsistent marker format).

Scrambled numbering: Article 13(2) repeats marker 'a.' twice; should be a., b., c. as in the original.
Scrambled numbering: Article 14(2) is merged into the website line instead of being a separate numbered item.
Scrambled numbering: Article 15(2) is merged into item (1) instead of being a separate numbered item.

Meaning drift risk due to merged markers (e.g., Article 10(4) and (5) combined on one line; Article 17(1) and (2) combined), requiring separation to preserve legal structure. (No substantive meaning change beyond structure detected.)

Meaning drift: Original Article 13(2) list markers are 'a., a., b.' (duplicate 'a'); translation normalizes them to 'a., b., c.', changing the list/numbering structure that must be preserved exactly.
Scrambled/merged numbering and list structure: in Article 26, item (2) is merged into item 1 instead of being a separate numbered point.
